Hi Elena,

Thanks for the demo last week — looking forward to getting Novus onboarded. Finance has put PO #12345 on hold pending tax paperwork: we need a completed W-8BEN-E (claiming treaty benefit) or a completed W-9 if you have a US tax classification.

If you intend to claim treaty benefits on W-8BEN-E but do not yet have a US TIN/EIN, please provide the following so we can assess an interim path:
- Signed W-8BEN-E (even if US TIN field is blank) signed by an authorized officer
- Copy of your foreign tax identifier (local TIN) and Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent
- Evidence of signing authority (board resolution or signed corporate certificate)
- A bank letter or company letterhead confirming legal name and business address (PDF)

Attaching the PO hold notice for reference. If you expect to obtain a US EIN soon please let us know timeline — that will speed release.

Can you share the documents by EOD Wed? If anything listed above is not possible, tell us what you can provide and we’ll coordinate with Finance.

Best,
Chloe Martin

Elena / Chloe — quick note from Finance.

Policy summary (applicable to non-US corporations claiming treaty benefits):
1) Standard: Completed W-8BEN-E with US TIN (EIN) for full PO activation.
2) Interim acceptance: if US TIN is pending, Finance can accept the following for a limited, provisional release:
   - Completed and signed W-8BEN-E with foreign TIN present
   - Certificate of incorporation AND a notarized corporate resolution confirming signing authority
   - Bank letter confirming corporate name and address (dated within 90 days)

If the above are provided and reviewed, we can authorize a provisional PO release for up to USD 25,000 or 90 days (whichever comes first) while the EIN application completes. Higher amounts or longer terms will need a full W-8BEN-E with US TIN.

Please submit PDFs to procurement@redwood.com. Also Elena, include expected EIN application date and any confirmation number from the SS-4 submission so we can track.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
